run_benchmark_main: run the CompactMask benchmark suite that compares dense and compact mask performance across multiple scenarios
run_scenario_benchmark: run a single benchmark scenario with specified objects, resolution, fill fraction, and polygon vertex count
summarize_benchmark_results: summarize benchmark results as a rich console table showing memory ratios and per-operation speedups
save_results_csv: save benchmark results to a CSV file with scenario metadata, memory footprints, and speedup columns
create_synthetic_detections: create synthetic detection data with random polygon masks given object count, image dimensions, and fill fraction
